rule.name: CSRF Protection Disabled or Not Applied
rule.rule_desc: The code disables, exempts, or configures request-forgery protection. Verify whether a reachable state-changing operation authenticates through automatically sent browser credentials.
rule.vuln_desc: An attacker may cause a victim’s browser to perform unwanted authenticated actions if the endpoint relies on ambient credentials and lacks an effective anti-forgery check.
rule.developer: Enforce anti-forgery protection on cookie-authenticated state changes, validate origins where appropriate, and justify exemptions only for independently authenticated non-browser flows.
rule.reviewer: Confirm CSRF middleware is applied to all POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH routes with Secure cookies. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Insecure Session Cookie Configuration
rule.rule_desc: The code handles session state or configures cookies and session secrets. Resolve cookie attributes, token generation, lifetime, and server-side validation.
rule.vuln_desc: Weak session secrets, exposed cookies, or inadequate expiry may allow session theft, token forgery, or continued access after the user’s intended authorization ends.
rule.developer: Use strong unpredictable session secrets, rotate tokens on privilege changes, and enforce expiry and revocation. Set Secure, HttpOnly, and appropriate SameSite attributes for sensitive browser cookies.
rule.reviewer: Verify session cookie options enforce Secure, HttpOnly, and appropriate SameSite policy. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Weak or Short Session Store Key
rule.rule_desc: The code handles session state or configures cookies and session secrets. Resolve cookie attributes, token generation, lifetime, and server-side validation.
rule.vuln_desc: Weak session secrets, exposed cookies, or inadequate expiry may allow session theft, token forgery, or continued access after the user’s intended authorization ends.
rule.developer: Use strong unpredictable session secrets, rotate tokens on privilege changes, and enforce expiry and revocation. Set Secure, HttpOnly, and appropriate SameSite attributes for sensitive browser cookies.
rule.reviewer: Confirm session store keys are sufficiently long (32+ bytes), randomly generated, and loaded from secure storage. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.
